metadata.name: MihalasNieburNeuron
metadata.author: Mihalaş, Ş.; Niebur, E.
metadata.description: Mihalas-Niebur generalised linear integrate-and-fire neuron (Mihalaş & Niebur 2009) — four-state RK4 flow with an adaptive threshold and two spike-triggered currents

extensions.threshold_dynamics_note: The threshold theta is a state variable, not a constant: it relaxes toward theta_inf while tracking the membrane through a*(v - v_rest), and each spike floors it up to theta_reset via max(theta, theta_reset). At the enrolled operating point theta_reset (1.3) exceeds theta_inf (1.0), so the max() floor engages on every spike and the state-to-state comparison v >= theta is a genuine adaptive threshold rather than a fixed level. The two spike-triggered currents i1, i2 decay with tau_1, tau_2 and are incremented by r1, r2 at each spike.
